name: riposte-social
description: A self-hosted social media sharing platform.

scripts.build: bun run build:admin && bun run build:social
scripts.a11y:smoke:docker: docker run --rm --network=host -e CYPRESS_BASE_URL=${CYPRESS_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3001} -e TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL -e TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e CYPRESS_VIDEO -e CYPRESS_SCREENSHOTS -v "$PWD":/e2e -w /e2e cypress/included:15.14.2 cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/a11y.cy.js
scripts.a11y:smoke:strict:docker: docker run --rm --network=host -e A11Y_STRICTNESS=strict -e CYPRESS_BASE_URL=${CYPRESS_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3001} -e TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL -e TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e CYPRESS_VIDEO -e CYPRESS_SCREENSHOTS -v "$PWD":/e2e -w /e2e cypress/included:15.14.2 cypress run --spec cypress/e2e/a11y.cy.js
scripts.e2e:feature:docker: docker run --rm --network=host -e CYPRESS_BASE_URL=${CYPRESS_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3001} -e TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL -e TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e CYPRESS_VIDEO -e CYPRESS_SCREENSHOTS -v "$PWD":/e2e -w /e2e cypress/included:15.14.2 cypress run --spec 'cypress/e2e/feed_kinds.cy.js,cypress/e2e/post_kind_routing.cy.js'
scripts.e2e:docker: docker run --rm --network=host -e CYPRESS_BASE_URL=${CYPRESS_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3001} -e TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL -e TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD -e CYPRESS_VIDEO -e CYPRESS_SCREENSHOTS -v "$PWD":/e2e -w /e2e cypress/included:15.14.2 cypress run

author: Grant DeFayette <grant@cavebatsofware.com>
